decisions.question: What stack and destination?
decisions.answer: Astro, TypeScript, CSS; GitHub Pages /notth-web/; new website repository.

decisions.question: Who approves milestones?
decisions.answer: Owner approves requirements before design, design before production UI completion, UAT before acceptance; no auto-merge or auto-release.

decisions.question: Initial content language and documentation scope?
decisions.answer: English homepage; official docs remain in framework repo.
